verdict.comment: Another chance is given to MOON D'ORANGE, who did very well to overcome a last-fence jumping error and win over C&D two rus ago.

comments.bhaloo: Came good when back on decent ground at Newbury last month; still unexposed over fences
comments.blowyourwad: Grade 2 novice winner last season; below form in a handicap on sole outing this term
comments.classicgetaway: 3-10 over fences after small-field Grade 2 win in February; on fairly tough handicap mark
comments.fugitif: Yet to reach peak form this season but on a good mark and suited by this C&D
comments.hanginthere: Second in this race last year but faces tough task under top weight today
comments.harpersbrook: Cajoled to narrow success in December but this quirky customer always comes with risk
comments.ilridoto: As good as ever in Paddy Power Gold Cup in November but below that form since
comments.moondorange: Not much went to plan for him at the festival but he won over C&D two starts ago
comments.omoorepark: Creditable third in C&D novices' handicap at last month's festival; player off same mark
comments.riskintheground: Surged back to best with ready win at Ayr on Friday; 10lb higher here; still considered

races.raceComment: harpersbrook is marginally preferred with a score of 62.6%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip over blowyourwad. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 5 wins from 18 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Excellent course form of 6/19 at cheltenham. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.oursdesoleil: Long last of four in 5f Musselburgh novice on debut, but was sent off 11-10 favourite

comments.dickieburd: Hasn't won since 2023 and has been off since October; cheekpieces refitted; new trainer

comments.goodearth: 13 wins, including one over C&D, as well as two handicaps elsewhere last year
comments.graceangel: Won a couple of handicaps elsewhere last year; solid third at Bath latest

comments.moonflight: Won similar race to this at Ayr (5f, good to firm) last June; back in some latest
comments.trilby: Won four sprint handicaps last year; got no sort of run at Doncaster on return

verdict.comment: This is tricky with doubts about the fitness of a few of them and the state of the ground. CROWN'S LADY gets a tentative vote.

comments.annaleelass: AW win in March came in classified company (about 1m); first turf run since 2023
comments.astronomica: Two 1m wins on soft; had a light 2024; forecast rain helpful; mark still on high side
comments.baydreambeliever: Back on much the same mark as her latest win (1m2f); reappearance record isn't strong
comments.beautifuldawn: Two AW wins in Ireland; in fair form on Tapeta in 2025 but has never run on turf
comments.casilli: Latest of 5 course wins was in 2022; just 4 runs in 2024 but capable of having a say
comments.cattonlady: Winless since 2yo debut but stays 1m, has course form and down slightly in weights
comments.coloane: Won over 1m last July; regressed on grass after but still 4lb higher than for the win
comments.crownslady: Won 3 handicaps in 2024; 2lb higher than latest; sold 34,000gns; new yard in form
comments.dandysangel: Runner-up in 2023 running; 11lb higher than the first of 3 autumn wins; cheekpieces off
comments.electricavenue: Won over 7f on turf last year and at 1m on AW for this yard; stamina query with this test
comments.mysticalmaria: Late finish to win at Carlisle (1m1f, soft) in August; return to similar trip can suit
comments.twobtanned: Hinted at ability in qualifying runs; soundly beaten in 3 handicaps; one to watch for now

races.raceComment: baydreambeliever is marginally preferred with a score of 48.9%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more reliable profile over astronomica.
